mode: Native browser with explicit simulated cloud failures

results.name: First-load network failure is not mislabeled as unsaved user edits
Repeated connection retries recover without duplicate notebook creation
Lost creation response is recovered by versioned read, not a second notebook
A clean cached page with failed revalidation is not a save conflict
Load cloud version after an actual failed save exits the recovery screen
Title always names the service after the separator
Diagnostics identify failing operation without recording keys or document text
Existing link failure keeps its board and never creates a replacement
Failed cloud reload preserves the draft until a read succeeds and Undo remains available
